methodology.gross: Where spreading is reported: gross long = long + spreading; gross short = short + spreading. Unreported spread buckets are not invented.
methodology.netPctOI: Net % OI = 100 × net / that snapshot’s OI.
methodology.weeklyFlow: Weekly flow % = 100 × change in net / previous snapshot’s OI. Weekly requires a comparable 6–8 day interval.
methodology.persistence: Two- and four-week flow = 100 × (current net − starting net) / starting OI; intervals must remain comparable. Percentages with changing denominators are not summed.
methodology.percentile: Empirical midrank against exactly the preceding 52 or 156 observations; current observation excluded. Ties count one half. This is not a min/max COT index or a price probability.
methodology.flowSize: Absolute flow percentile ranks absolute weekly normalized changes; signed flow percentile retains direction.
methodology.bias: Qualitative component reading: CL emphasizes managed money; NQ and ES describe asset manager and leveraged-fund agreement or disagreement. No arbitrary weighted score.
methodology.comparison: NQ and ES are compared using net / own OI and net change / own previous OI. Raw contracts are not treated as equivalent dollar risk.
methodology.refresh: Saved official snapshot. Refresh requires a newly verified data build; it does not silently change when the page opens.
